name: Colorado 13er

location.name: Louisville, CO
location.address: Home Depot, 1200 Dillon Road, Louisville, CO 80027

description: The Colorado 13er is an exceptionally scenic, looped half marathon (13.1 miles) that combines trail running and road racing through Louisville, Colorado with spectacular views of the Flatirons. The course features 9 miles of flat, crushed gravel with 10 water stations, 5 port-a-john passes, free parking, and is chip-timed with live results. All participants receive a performance tee and finishers receive a collector's pint glass. Half marathon finishers also receive a collector's finisher medal. 5K and 10K options are available.

description: Pikes Peak Ultra is an ultramarathon event featuring multiple distance options (20K, 30K, 50K, and 50 Mile) starting at Bear Creek Regional Park in Colorado Springs. The course winds through stunning trails including High Drive, Cheyenne Canon, Seven Bridges Trail, and Pipeline Trail, with much of the course on crushed granite. name: Leadville Trail 100 MTB
description: The Life Time Leadville Trail 100 MTB is one of the most prestigious endurance cross-country mountain bike events in the world. Riders tackle a grueling 100-mile course with approximately 12,000 feet of elevation gain, starting at 10,152 feet and reaching a peak elevation of 12,500 feet at Columbine Mine. The race is known as 'Race Across the Sky' and offers finishers the coveted silver and gold beltbuckle. Lottery registration opens December 1-15, 2026 with results announced January 6, 2027. Entry fee: $575.

name: Pikes Peak Marathon
distance: Marathon (26.2 miles) / Ascent (13.3 miles) / Garden To Peak Challenge

location.name: Manitou Springs, CO
location.address: 441 Manitou Ave, Suite 100, Manitou Springs, CO 80829

description: The Pikes Peak Marathon, founded in 1956, is the oldest continually held marathon in the United States. It takes runners from Manitou Springs, Colorado, to the summit of Pikes Peak at 14,115 feet and back down for a total of 26.2 grueling mountain miles, climbing approximately 7,800 vertical feet up the historic Barr Trail. The sister race, the Pikes Peak Ascent, is a 13.3-mile climb to the summit.

name: Snow Mountain Ranch Trail Running Festival
description: The 13th annual Snow Mountain Ranch Trail Running Festival features 5 races on wide open Nordic tracks at the YMCA of the Rockies. Courses are 100% dirt terrain with stunning views of changing colors, rolling hills, and picturesque landscapes. Races include a 50K (31.4 miles, 4,236 ft elevation gain), 33K (20.2 miles, 2,443 ft elevation gain), Half Marathon (12.8 miles, 1,707 ft elevation gain), 10K, and 5K. Registration closes September 13, 2027 at 11:59 PM MT.
